description: Stops forwarding one address at a site's domain, as Remove in the domain's settings does; email sent to it is no longer passed on within a few minutes. Removing the last address switches forwarding at that domain off. Only owners and admins.

domain.description: The domain, as list_email_forwarding lists it, such as acme.com.

mailbox.description: The address to stop forwarding: the part before the @ (info for info@acme.com), or * for every address no other line names.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: remove_email_forwarding
title: Stop forwarding an address
